title: kate-ui: tell when a highlight step needs paint
summary: needs_paint is true when a step has work. A zero budget behind the checkpoint is idle. The test goes in the existing highlight tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: highlight.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add needs_paint on impl HighlightStep. Keep it pub(crate). The body is one expression: self.ensure_through.is_some() || self.plain_from.is_some(). Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch highlight_step, resume_color_line, plain_line, or the HighlightStep fields. The existing tests a_zero_budget_starts_plain_at_the_checkpoint and a_zero_budget_keeps_color_behind stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_zero_budget_behind_the_checkpoint_needs_no_paint calls highlight_step of checkpoint 1000, first 10, last 50, and budget 0. needs_paint is false. highlight_step of 0, 0, 39, and budget 0 has needs_paint true. highlight_step of 0, 0, 39, and budget 40 has needs_paint true. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: highlight::tests::a_zero_budget_behind_the_checkpoint_needs_no_paint
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because needs_paint does not exist. After the change a step with no ensure range and no plain start is false. A plain start is true. An ensure range is true.
